# IT Security and Performance Review Action Items

This document outlines critical tasks and investigations required within the IT & Digital department, primarily driven by audit findings and ongoing security and performance monitoring needs.

## Action Items

*   Review encryption standards quarterly.
*   Investigate database migration based on audit findings.
*   Monitor API latency based on audit findings.
*   Update the database migration standard.
*   Urgently investigate encryption standards.
